question: Should this PR wait for an exact stable 2026.7.1 publication and successful fresh-setup proof before making it the Windows setup LKG?
rationale: Selecting an LKG is a release-quality decision, and the current candidate is not an installable stable package even though beta builds exist.

options.title: Wait for stable publication
options.body: Keep the draft open, refresh it only when exact version 2026.7.1 is published, and merge after required tests plus fresh setup runtime proof succeed.

options.title: Keep 2026.6.11
options.body: Close or supersede this bump if the July stable release is delayed or does not pass Windows setup validation.

options.title: Adopt an explicit beta
options.body: Change the pin to the full beta version only if maintainers intentionally want default fresh installs on the prerelease channel.

recommendation.title: Wait for stable publication
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open, refresh it only when exact version 2026.7.1 is published, and merge after required tests plus fresh setup runtime proof succeed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history ties this person most directly to Windows setup and setup-connect E2E maintenance.
